Scattered plasma cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei are present in the background along with occasional granulocytes. The field is somewhat thick and smeared, limiting quantitation. In the clinical context, findings represent osteoclasts accompanying a plasma cell neoplasm, reflecting increased bone resorption in multiple myeloma; plasma cell percentage should be assessed on a well-spread area and with CD138 on biopsy.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated, interconnected nucleus, whereas osteoclasts have multiple separate, uniform round nuclei.
Neoplastic multinucleated plasma cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and fewer (2-4) atypical nuclei, unlike the many uniform nuclei in pale cytoplasm of osteoclasts.
Metastatic cells form cohesive clusters of separate cells with cell borders, nuclear pleomorphism and molding, rather than a syncytium of identical nuclei.

61958.recognize_zh: CD4染色中成片大型細胞呈清楚的膜狀強陽性，核大、淡染泡狀並有核仁，陽性細胞呈黏著性排列，說明腫瘤性大型T細胞表現CD4，符合ALCL最常見的CD4+表型。
features: Sheets of large cells with strong, crisp membranous CD4 staining
Large oval to irregular nuclei with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant cytoplasm with cohesive cell arrangement
Occasional negative cells interspersed; background staining of cytoplasm
61958.describe_en: CD4 immunostain shows strong membranous staining in sheets of large neoplastic cells with vesicular nuclei and abundant cytoplasm, arranged in a cohesive pattern. A minority of interspersed cells are negative. CD4 expression by the large cells supports a T-cell phenotype, as is typical of anaplastic large cell lymphoma, which is more often CD4-positive than CD8-positive.

ddx.vs: Histiocytes are also CD4-positive, but histiocytic sarcoma expresses CD163/CD68 and lacks strong CD30 and cytotoxic granule proteins.
BPDCN is CD4+ but co-expresses CD56, CD123, TCF4 and TCL1 with blastic chromatin, and is CD30-negative.
AITL CD4+ cells are small-to-medium with clear cytoplasm and express TFH markers around expanded FDC meshworks, not sheets of large CD30+ cells.

61894.recognize_zh: 皮膚深層真皮/皮下組織中，CD4 只標記散在的少數淋巴球及部分樹突狀形態的細胞（可能為組織球），大部分浸潤細胞為陰性；這是 HV 樣淋巴增生性疾病（HVLPD）免疫表型分析的一張 CD4 染色。
features: Edematous, pale dermal collagen/subcutis with a moderate interstitial and perivascular mononuclear infiltrate
Scattered CD4-positive cells, a minority of the infiltrate
Some positive cells have dendritic or irregular cytoplasmic processes, suggesting admixed histiocytes
Positive cells more numerous around small vessels on the right side of the field
Most small lymphoid nuclei are CD4 negative
61894.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD4 on a skin biopsy shows an interstitial and perivascular mononuclear infiltrate within edematous dermis/subcutis. CD4 highlights only scattered cells, some with dendritic cytoplasmic processes consistent with admixed histiocytes, and a minority of small lymphocytes clustered around small vessels. The majority of the infiltrating lymphoid cells are CD4 negative. In the context of an EBER-positive infiltrate, this pattern argues against a CD4-predominant T-cell process and should be interpreted together with CD3, CD8 and CD56 stains for hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: That entity forms a dense dermal nodule dominated by CD4-positive small/medium T cells with PD-1-positive large cells and is EBER negative, unlike the sparse CD4 staining here.

ENKTL shows angiocentric, angiodestructive growth with necrosis and CD56-positive, cytoplasmic CD3-positive cells, typically in adults, whereas HVLPD is a vesiculopapular photodistributed disease of children and young adults.
SPTCL shows rimming of adipocytes by atypical CD8-positive, beta F1-positive cells and is EBER negative.

61830.recognize_zh: CD163 在大多數大型多形腫瘤細胞呈強烈的膜與細胞質陽性，上方一區小型細胞則陰性；CD163 是較專一的組織球/巨噬細胞標記，強陽性支持組織球肉瘤。
features: Sheets of large pleomorphic cells with abundant cytoplasm
Strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD163 staining in the majority of tumor cells
Round to irregular nuclei with occasional large bizarre forms outlined by stain
Adjacent zone of smaller CD163-negative cells at the top of the field
Loose, discohesive growth pattern
61830.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD163 shows strong, diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic positivity in sheets of large, discohesive, pleomorphic neoplastic cells, with an adjacent area of smaller negative cells. CD163 is a hemoglobin-haptoglobin scavenger receptor that is more specific for monocyte/macrophage lineage than CD68. Together with CD68 and PU.1 expression and absence of B-, T-, dendritic, myeloid precursor, melanocytic, and epithelial markers, findings are consistent with histiocytic sarcoma.

ddx.dx: Tumor-associated macrophages in carcinoma or lymphoma
ddx.vs: Background macrophages are scattered and cytologically bland, whereas here the atypical tumor cells themselves are diffusely CD163 positive.
LC sarcoma is CD1a+/Langerin+ and usually CD163 negative or weak.
FDC sarcoma is CD21/CD23/CD35 positive with a spindled whorled pattern rather than CD163-positive large round cells.
Monocytic blasts can express CD163 but have finer blastic chromatin, and a concurrent marrow or blood leukemia with CD34/CD117 or lysozyme profile supports myeloid sarcoma.

61766.recognize_zh: PAX5 免疫染色中幾乎所有腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫、密集的棕色核陽性，片狀排列並夾雜圓形脂肪空泡，證實為 B 細胞腫瘤；PAX5 本身無法區分亞型，母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤需靠 cyclin D1/SOX11 確認。
features: Diffuse sheets of tumor cells with strong nuclear PAX5 positivity in the vast majority of cells
Nuclei are medium-sized, round to oval and closely packed, with a monotonous distribution
Scattered PAX5-negative cells with blue nuclei (likely stromal, T cells or residual hematopoietic elements)
Round clear spaces consistent with adipocytes interspersed within the infiltrate
Faint background cytoplasmic blush without true membranous staining
61766.describe_en: PAX5 immunohistochemistry shows a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of medium-sized cells with strong nuclear positivity, interspersed with adipocytes and occasional negative background cells. The staining confirms the B-cell lineage of the infiltrate but is not specific for subtype. In the context of the stated diagnosis, the findings are consistent with involvement by blastoid mantle cell lymphoma, which requires confirmation by cyclin D1 and/or SOX11 positivity or CCND1 rearrangement and assessment of Ki-67.

ddx.vs: Also PAX5 positive with blastic morphology but expresses TdT and/or CD34 and lacks cyclin D1 and SOX11.
PAX5 positive large cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli that are cyclin D1 negative (or only weakly positive in a subset) and lack CCND1 rearrangement.
Myeloblasts may aberrantly express PAX5 but are MPO, CD34 and CD117 positive and negative for CD20 and cyclin D1.
Shows a starry-sky pattern, CD10 positivity, near-100% Ki-67 and MYC rearrangement without cyclin D1.

61702.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見大量漿細胞夾雜在骨髓球系前驅細胞之間：核偏心、染色質粗塊狀、深藍胞質並有明顯核旁淡染區（hof），數量明顯增加，是骨髓瘤骨髓抹片的典型樣貌。
features: Markedly increased plasma cells, many in clusters
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous in most cells
Abundant deep-blue cytoplasm with prominent perinuclear hof
Occasional larger plasma cells with more open chromatin
Residual granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands) and red cells in the background
Numerous fat vacuoles consistent with a particle-rich aspirate
61702.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with markedly increased plasma cells present singly and in clusters among residual granulocytic precursors. The plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and a distinct perinuclear hof; most are mature-appearing, with occasional larger forms. Maturing myeloid elements are present in the background, and no blasts are increased in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by plasma cell myeloma; a 500-cell differential and clonality studies are recommended.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis (infection, autoimmune disease, liver disease)
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are usually fewer, scattered, and polytypic by flow or kappa/lambda staining, whereas this marrow shows clustered, markedly increased plasma cells.
MGUS has <10% clonal plasma cells without CRAB/SLiM features, which is distinguished by a plasma cell count and clinical data rather than cytology.
LPL has predominant small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell population.

61638.recognize_zh: CD31 染色勾勒出竇狀血管內皮的細長棕色輪廓，腔內的大型、核卵圓的腫瘤細胞本身為陰性，另有大型陽性的巨核細胞與零星陽性小細胞；用內皮標記證明大細胞「位於血管內」是血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的輔助工具。
features: CD31 highlights thin endothelial linings of dilated sinusoids
Large CD31-negative cells with oval vesicular nuclei located within the outlined vascular lumina
Strongly CD31-positive megakaryocyte serving as internal control
Scattered small CD31-positive myeloid cells/platelets in the interstitium
Fat spaces and residual hematopoiesis between sinusoids
61638.describe_en: CD31 immunostain outlines the endothelial lining of dilated marrow sinusoids. Large atypical cells with oval vesicular nuclei lie within the endothelium-bound lumina and are themselves CD31 negative. A megakaryocyte and scattered small myeloid cells are CD31 positive, consistent with the known expression of CD31 in these cells. The endothelial outline confirms the intravascular location of the large atypical cells, supporting intravascular large B-cell lymphoma when combined with CD20 positivity.

ddx.vs: In a vascular tumor the atypical cells themselves are CD31/ERG positive, whereas here the large cells within the lumina are CD31 negative.
Extravascular lymphoma cells lie outside the CD31-outlined sinusoids in interstitial sheets.
Also located within CD31/CD34-outlined sinusoids but composed of medium-sized CD3-positive, CD20-negative cells.

61574.recognize_zh: CD45 對側向散射（SSC）圖中，一大群 CD45 弱表現、低 SSC 的細胞落在「blasts」閘門內佔 82.39%，正常顆粒球僅 2.14%、單核球 0.20%；典型「CD45 dim 母細胞區」大量擴張，代表急性白血病（此例 B-ALL）取代正常造血。
features: CD45-KO (x-axis, log) versus side scatter SS INT (y-axis, linear) dot plot
Dominant population in the CD45-dim, low-SSC blast gate, labeled 82.39%
Markedly reduced granulocytes (Gr 2.14%) in the CD45-moderate, high-SSC region
Very few monocytes (Mono 0.20%)
Small residual lymphocyte cluster with bright CD45 and low SSC
61574.describe_en: This CD45 versus side-scatter flow cytometry plot shows a dominant population in the CD45-dim, low-side-scatter region, gated as blasts and accounting for 82.39% of events. Normal populations are markedly reduced, with granulocytes 2.14%, monocytes 0.20% and a small residual CD45-bright lymphocyte cluster. This pattern indicates replacement of normal hematopoiesis by a blast population and is consistent with acute leukemia; lineage assignment requires further antigen analysis, which in this case supports B-lymphoblastic leukemia. Note that percentages are relative to gated events and may differ from the morphologic blast count.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts also sit in the CD45-dim/low-SSC region; lineage-specific markers (MPO, CD13, CD33, CD117 vs CD19, CD10, cCD79a) are required.
Hematogones fall in a CD45-dim-to-moderate low-SSC area but show a normal maturation continuum and rarely reach such a high percentage with near absence of granulocytes.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell neoplasm or nucleated red cells
ddx.vs: Plasma cells and erythroid precursors can be CD45-negative/dim with low SSC but are CD38/CD138-bright or CD71/CD235a-positive rather than CD34/CD19/CD10.

61510.recognize_zh: 雖然標題寫骨髓纖維化，此圖其實是周邊血液抹片：紅血球大小形狀不一，可見數個淚滴狀紅血球（dacrocyte）與橢圓形紅血球，中央有一個邊緣不規則的巨大血小板；淚滴細胞是骨髓纖維化在血液中的間接線索。
features: Moderate anisopoikilocytosis with several teardrop-shaped red cells (dacrocytes)
Scattered elliptocytes/ovalocytes and occasional target-like cells
Large atypical platelet with irregular cytoplasmic projections in the center of the field
Normal-sized platelets present in adequate numbers
No nucleated red cells or immature granulocytes in this field
61510.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows moderate anisopoikilocytosis with several teardrop-shaped red cells (dacrocytes) and scattered elliptocytes. A large atypical platelet with irregular cytoplasmic projections is present, along with normal-sized platelets. Nucleated red cells and immature myeloid cells, which would complete a leukoerythroblastic picture, are not seen in this field. Although the title refers to marrow fibrosis, this image shows only blood findings; in conjunction with a marrow biopsy with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and reticulin fibrosis, these findings are consistent with primary myelofibrosis, fibrotic stage.

ddx.vs: Myelophthisic marrow also produces dacrocytes and a leukoerythroblastic picture, so separation requires a biopsy showing tumor cells rather than MPN megakaryocytes.
Thalassemia shows microcytosis with targets and basophilic stippling, and megaloblastic anemia shows macro-ovalocytes with hypersegmented neutrophils, each with occasional teardrops.
Post-PV and post-ET myelofibrosis are morphologically identical in blood and marrow and are distinguished only by a documented prior PV or ET.
Smearing artifact produces teardrop tails all pointing in the same direction, whereas true dacrocytes are randomly oriented.

61446.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中有一團上皮樣組織球聚集，組織球胞質內可見多個約 2–4 µm、周圍有透明暈的小圓形酵母菌（halo），大小一致，符合莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）骨髓浸潤。
features: Loose aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Small, uniform intracellular round-oval yeast forms (about 2-4 μm) with a central basophilic dot and surrounding clear halo within histiocytes
Admixed small lymphocytes, plasma cells and occasional spindled cells
Adjacent residual hematopoietic cells at lower left
No well-formed necrotizing granuloma or multinucleated giant cells in this field
61446.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a poorly formed aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with pale vacuolated cytoplasm, accompanied by lymphocytes and plasma cells. Within the histiocytes are numerous small, uniform intracellular yeast forms with a clear halo, measuring approximately 2-4 μm. No necrosis is seen in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by Histoplasma capsulatum; confirmation with GMS/PAS stains, urine/serum antigen, and culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a halo, and are GMS-negative.
Yeasts divide by fission with a transverse septum and may be elongated, rather than narrow-based budding.
C. glabrata is slightly larger and Cryptococcus shows variable size with a mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Pneumocystis cysts are extracellular in foamy exudate and Toxoplasma bradyzoites form tissue cysts, not intrahistiocytic haloed yeasts.

61382.recognize_zh: 一顆大型紅系前驅細胞具豐富灰藍色（多色性）細胞質，內含一個主核與數個大小不一的圓形核碎片及微核（nuclear fragmentation / karyorrhexis），是明顯的紅系發育異常（dyserythropoiesis）。
features: Large erythroid precursor with abundant gray-blue polychromatophilic cytoplasm
One dominant nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin accompanied by several smaller round nuclear fragments of varying size
Multiple tiny micronuclei/chromatin particles adjacent to the nuclear fragments
Irregular cell outline; no cytoplasmic granules
Surrounding erythrocytes with mild poikilocytosis and scattered platelets
61382.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large erythroid precursor with abundant polychromatophilic cytoplasm containing a dominant nucleus with clumped chromatin and multiple smaller round nuclear fragments and micronuclei. Surrounding red cells show mild poikilocytosis. Nuclear fragmentation with multinuclearity is a feature of dyserythropoiesis; in a patient with prior cytotoxic or immunosuppressive therapy, this is consistent with dysplasia of a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm, although drug effect, megaloblastic change and other non-neoplastic causes must be excluded clinically.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic precursors show open sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant metamyelocytes, and resolve with vitamin replacement or drug withdrawal.
CDA presents from childhood with binucleated or internuclear bridging erythroblasts confined to the erythroid lineage without cytogenetic abnormalities of MDS.
Apoptotic cells show shrunken, uniformly dense chromatin fragments with condensed cytoplasm rather than an intact viable cell with polychromatic cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes have granular pink cytoplasm and are much larger, with lobes connected rather than discrete round erythroid-type nuclear fragments.

61190.recognize_zh: 高倍下組織球被細長、平行條紋狀的粉紅色結晶撐滿，細胞核被擠到極邊緣，看起來像橫紋肌；其間夾雜核呈多葉、染色質粗塊的大型淋巴瘤細胞。
features: Histiocytes distended by elongated, bright eosinophilic crystalline material with parallel striations
Histiocyte nuclei compressed to the extreme periphery of the cell
Interspersed large atypical lymphoid cells with polylobated, flower-like nuclei and coarse chromatin
Scattered small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei
Striated pink cytoplasm mimics skeletal muscle fibers
61190.describe_en: High-power view shows histiocytes distended by elongated, bright eosinophilic crystalline structures with parallel striations and nuclei displaced to the extreme periphery. Between them are scattered large atypical lymphoid cells with polylobated nuclei and coarse chromatin, along with small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells. The striated appearance can mimic rhabdoid or skeletal muscle cells. Findings are consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis associated with a large cell lymphoma; CD68/CD163 and immunoglobulin light-chain stains on the histiocytes and a lymphoma panel on the atypical cells are recommended.

ddx.vs: Muscle cells show true cross-striations and desmin/myogenin positivity, while crystal-storing histiocytes are CD68 positive and stain for monotypic light chain.
Rhabdomyoma cells contain glycogen vacuoles and 'spider cells' with desmin positivity, not CD68-positive crystal-laden histiocytes.
Langerhans cells have grooved nuclei with pale cytoplasm and are CD1a/langerin positive, lacking crystalline inclusions.

61126.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀圖：CD45/SSC 圖上低 SSC、CD45 陰性的一群為母細胞（28.53%），再以 CD19 圈出 CD19+ 母細胞；後續圖顯示 CD34 陽性、CD38 弱或陰性、CD20 陰性、CD10 大多陰性，並異常表現 CD33 與 CD58，符合 B 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: CD45 vs side scatter: blast gate with negative CD45 and low SSC comprising 28.53% of live events, distinct from granulocytes (54.20%) and lymphocytes
CD19 vs CD45: CD19-positive, CD45-negative blasts (27.41%) separated from residual normal CD19+ lymphocytes (0.83%)
CD19+ blasts: CD20 negative; CD10 largely negative with a partial CD10-positive subset (23.79%)
CD19+ blasts: CD34 positive with dim to negative CD38 (99.64%)
CD19+ blasts: uniform CD58 bright and aberrant CD33 co-expression (99.53%)
61126.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis demonstrates an abnormal population occupying 28.53% of live events in the CD45-negative, low side scatter region. Sequential gating shows that these events are CD19-positive blasts (27.41%) that are CD34 positive, CD38 dim to negative, CD20 negative, predominantly CD10 negative with a partial CD10-positive subset, and uniformly positive for CD58 with aberrant CD33 expression. Residual normal CD19-positive lymphocytes are few. The immunophenotype is consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia; the CD10-negative/partial and myeloid antigen-positive profile warrants cytogenetic and molecular studies (e.g., KMT2A rearrangement, BCR::ABL1-like alterations) and establishes a baseline for measurable residual disease monitoring.

ddx.vs: Hematogones show a continuous maturation spectrum with CD45 dim-to-positive, variable CD34/CD10/CD20 and no aberrant CD33 or uniformly bright CD58.
MPAL requires MPO positivity or monocytic differentiation, whereas CD33 alone is an insufficient myeloid-lineage criterion.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with CD19 expression
ddx.vs: AML with t(8;21) may express CD19 weakly but is MPO positive, CD13/CD117 positive and usually PAX5 weak, lacking strong B-lineage antigens.

61062.recognize_zh: 數個漿細胞核圓形偏位、染色質呈車輪狀，周圍有大量淡藍紫色、邊緣不規則呈毛邊或火焰狀外擴的細胞質；與典型鮮紅色火焰細胞不同，這裡的細胞質色澤較淡（pale flame），背景有蛋白質性絲狀沉積。
features: Plasma cells with round, eccentric nuclei and coarse clock-face chromatin; occasional small nucleolus
Abundant cytoplasm with pale lavender to light blue staining and frayed, flame-like irregular borders
Cytoplasm lacks the intense magenta/red periphery of classic flame cells (pale variant)
Background of fibrillary/streaky proteinaceous material with rouleaux-prone red cells
Low overall cellularity in this field; weakly stained preparation
61062.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and clock-face chromatin, each surrounded by abundant pale lavender-blue cytoplasm with irregular, frayed, flame-like borders. The characteristic bright red-magenta cytoplasmic rim of classic flame cells is not seen, giving a pale variant appearance. The background contains streaky proteinaceous material. In a patient with IgA kappa myeloma, findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with flame cell morphology; flame cells are classically associated with IgA myeloma but are not specific.

ddx.vs: Reactive flame cells occur in low numbers among polytypic plasma cells, whereas myeloma shows ≥10% clonal plasma cells with light-chain restriction.
Gaucher cells have small central/eccentric nuclei with abundant wrinkled-tissue-paper cytoplasm and lack the clock-face chromatin and perinuclear hof of plasma cells.
Osteoblasts have a hof distant from the nucleus and occur in clusters, while megakaryocytic fragments contain granular pink cytoplasm without an eccentric round plasmacytoid nucleus.
Mott cells contain multiple round clear or pale globules of immunoglobulin rather than diffusely frayed pale cytoplasm.

60998.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被瀰漫的淋巴樣浸潤取代，免疫染色顯示成片的 T 細胞背景；另一群大型、核奇特的「退行性（anaplastic）」樣細胞（插圖）只分布在擴張的淋巴竇內，且以竇狀分布的核染色（推測為 EBER）標示出來。
features: Low power (A): effaced lymph node architecture by a diffuse lymphoid infiltrate; inset shows medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells
IHC (B, C): large areas of positive cells in a diffuse/interfollicular pattern consistent with a neoplastic T-cell population (antibodies not labeled)
Higher power (D): sinusoidal spaces containing large cells; inset shows large pleomorphic/anaplastic cells with abundant cytoplasm and bizarre nuclei
IHC/ISH (E, F): positive large cells confined to the subcapsular and medullary sinuses, highlighting a sinusoidal distribution (markers not labeled; F nuclear pattern suggests EBER)
Image resolution limits cytologic detail
60998.describe_en: Lymph node sections show architectural effacement by a diffuse atypical lymphoid infiltrate, with immunostains highlighting an extensive T-cell population. In addition, large pleomorphic cells with abundant cytoplasm and bizarre nuclei are present, distributed within and confined to lymph node sinuses, where they are highlighted by further immunostains and a nuclear stain pattern suggestive of EBER in situ hybridization. The specific markers are not labeled in the figure and cytology is limited by resolution. Findings are consistent with peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS, accompanied by an EBV-driven large B-cell proliferation with anaplastic morphology restricted to sinuses, which should not be mistaken for anaplastic large cell lymphoma or a composite B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: ALCL hallmark cells are strong uniform CD30+ T cells (often cytotoxic) and EBV negative, whereas these sinusoidal large cells are EBV+ B cells (CD20/PAX5+).
AITL has expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks, arborizing HEVs and TFH-marker (PD1, ICOS, CXCL13) expression, often with EBV+ B blasts scattered rather than sinus-confined.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in sinuses
ddx.vs: Sinusoidal metastases are keratin or S100/SOX10 positive and CD45/EBER negative.
A true composite shows a sheet-like clonal B-cell lymphoma forming mass lesions with proven B-cell clonality, not a sinus-restricted proliferation.

60998.stain: H&E; IHC and ISH (markers not labeled)

60806.recognize_zh: 肝細胞板之間的竇狀隙被一群中等大小、核呈卵圓或腎形、周圍帶透亮胞質的淋巴細胞填滿，細胞彼此有間距、如「煎蛋」般排列，這種竇內透亮細胞浸潤正是毛細胞白血病侵犯肝臟的樣貌。
features: Dilated hepatic sinusoids filled with small clusters of monotonous lymphoid cells
Oval to reniform nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Clear to pale cytoplasm creating a halo and even nuclear spacing (fried-egg appearance)
Intervening hepatocyte plates preserved, with finely granular cytoplasm and focal brown pigment
No portal-based nodules, necrosis or mitotic activity evident in this field
60806.describe_en: Liver section shows expansion of hepatic sinusoids by clusters of medium-sized lymphoid cells with oval to bean-shaped nuclei and abundant clear cytoplasm that imparts a spaced, fried-egg appearance. The hepatocyte plates are preserved and compressed between the infiltrated sinusoids, and no destructive portal nodules are seen in this field. The sinusoidal distribution of clear lymphoid cells is consistent with hepatic involvement by hairy cell leukemia, confirmed by CD20, CD25, CD11c and TRAP immunostains.

ddx.vs: Also sinusoidal, but cells are medium-sized with scant cytoplasm and are CD3+ T cells (usually gamma-delta), not CD20+/CD25+ B cells.
Favors portal-tract nodules with small cells and plasmacytoid features rather than purely sinusoidal clear cells, and lacks annexin A1/CD25.
Sinusoidal cells include erythroid precursors, megakaryocytes and myeloid forms rather than a monotonous clear-cell lymphoid population.
Similar pattern but cells have prominent nucleoli and lack CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.

60614.recognize_zh: 移植後骨髓切片中為中大型異常細胞與小淋巴球混合浸潤，免疫染色顯示大量小至中型細胞呈強膜或胞質陽性（淋巴球標記），穿插在殘存的腫瘤細胞之間；抗體未標示，需搭配原文判讀為供者 T 細胞攻擊白血病細胞（graft-versus-leukemia）。
features: H&E: cellular marrow with a mixed population of intermediate to large cells with vesicular nuclei and small nucleoli admixed with small lymphocytes and pale histiocyte-like cells
Immunostain B: dot-like/granular cytoplasmic and membranous staining in a subset of infiltrating cells
Immunostain C: strong cytoplasmic/membranous staining of numerous small to intermediate cells, interspersed with negative larger cells
Immunostain D: diffuse membranous staining of a dense cell population
Antibodies are not labeled; image resolution does not allow definitive lineage assignment
60614.describe_en: The post-transplant bone marrow biopsy (H&E) shows a cellular infiltrate composed of intermediate to large atypical cells intermixed with numerous small lymphocytes and histiocytes. A panel of immunohistochemical stains demonstrates a dense population of positively staining lymphoid cells with membranous and cytoplasmic patterns, closely apposed to negative larger residual cells, while another stain shows granular dot-like positivity in a subset of cells. Because the antibodies are not identified in the figure, lineage cannot be assigned from the image alone. In the appropriate post-transplant context, findings are suggestive of a donor T-cell infiltrate targeting residual leukemia (graft-versus-leukemia effect), which should be supported by chimerism studies and immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Pure relapse shows sheets of blasts without a dense admixed cytotoxic T-cell population.
PTLD is usually an EBV-positive B-cell proliferation, demonstrated by EBER and B-cell markers rather than a T-cell infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Graft-versus-host disease–related marrow aplasia with lymphocytosis
ddx.vs: GVHD-associated marrow shows hypocellularity with lymphocytes but no residual leukemic cells.
PTCL shows cytologically atypical T cells with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR rearrangement rather than reactive donor T cells.

60678.recognize_zh: 關節液抹片中大量嗜中性球之間，散在成群、細胞質深藍的大型非典型淋巴瘤細胞（箭頭尖）；同一視野中嗜中性球內另有細長針狀結晶（箭頭），偏光下呈亮白雙折射，符合痛風尿酸鈉結晶與淋巴瘤共存。
features: Panel A (x20): hypercellular joint fluid dominated by neutrophils, with scattered clusters of large cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Panel B (x100): large atypical lymphoid cells (arrowheads) with round nuclei, fine chromatin and a rim of intensely basophilic cytoplasm, several times the size of neutrophils
Panel B: slender needle-shaped crystal within a neutrophil (arrow)
Panel C (polarized light): the needle-shaped crystal (arrow) is brightly birefringent against the dark background
Background brown-stained amorphous material, likely crystalline or proteinaceous debris
60678.describe_en: Synovial fluid cytospin shows a marked neutrophilic infiltrate with scattered clusters of large atypical lymphoid cells having round nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. A neutrophil contains an intracellular needle-shaped crystal that is brightly birefringent on polarized light, consistent with monosodium urate. Findings are consistent with coexistent lymphoma involvement of the joint fluid and acute gouty arthritis; flow cytometry of the fluid and compensated polarized microscopy (negative birefringence) are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: CPPD crystals are rhomboid or short rods with weak positive birefringence, whereas urate crystals are long needles with strong negative birefringence.

ddx.dx: Reactive synovial lining cells or macrophages
ddx.vs: Synoviocytes and macrophages have more abundant pale or vacuolated cytoplasm and bland nuclei, not the intensely basophilic cytoplasm and blastic chromatin of lymphoma cells.
Septic fluid shows neutrophils with bacteria on Gram stain or culture and lacks large atypical lymphoid cells.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells or immunoblasts in inflammatory arthritis
ddx.vs: Reactive immunoblasts are few, polytypic and mixed with small lymphocytes, whereas lymphoma cells form monotonous clusters with clonal immunophenotype.

60742.recognize_zh: 周邊血與骨髓中出現中至大型、核染色質細緻、類似母細胞的非典型細胞，細胞質灰藍、邊緣不規則並有偽足狀突起與細小空泡，外觀像急性白血病；須以流式確認為 γδ T 細胞才可診斷肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Medium-to-large blast-like cells with fine, finely granular (blastoid) chromatin and indistinct nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale gray-blue to violet cytoplasm with irregular outlines and pseudopod-like tails
Occasional small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles and fine pale granules
Bone marrow aspirate (B): sheets of similar cells, some with visible nucleoli, among a few residual precursors
Stain rendering is magenta-tinted, limiting chromatin detail
60742.describe_en: Peripheral blood and bone marrow aspirate smears contain a population of medium-to-large atypical cells with fine blastoid chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and a moderate rim of pale gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular pseudopodal projections and scattered small vacuoles. The marrow aspirate is heavily replaced by the same cells. Morphology alone suggests an acute leukemia; the stain tint limits chromatin assessment. In the appropriate setting of hepatosplenomegaly with a CD3+, CD4−/CD8−, TCRγδ+ phenotype, findings are consistent with hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma presenting in a leukemic, blastoid form.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts are MPO/NSE and CD33/CD64 positive, while HSTCL cells express CD3 and TCRγδ with absent myeloid markers.
T-ALL blasts are TdT+ and often CD1a+/cytoplasmic CD3+ with scant cytoplasm, whereas HSTCL cells are mature (TdT-negative) cytotoxic γδ T cells.
T-LGL cells are small mature lymphocytes with abundant cytoplasm and coarse azurophilic granules, not blastoid cells, and follow an indolent course.
ANKL cells are surface CD3-negative, CD56+ and EBV-positive, while HSTCL is EBV-negative with surface CD3 and TCRγδ.

captions: Peripheral blood: large blastoid cell with fine chromatin and irregular vacuolated cytoplasm
Peripheral blood: atypical cells with pseudopod-like cytoplasmic tails
Bone marrow aspirate: large atypical cells with pale cytoplasm
Bone marrow aspirate: sheet of blastoid lymphoma cells

60486.recognize_zh: 大型不典型細胞片狀排列，只有部分細胞呈膜性／細胞質 CD5 棕色陽性，許多大型腫瘤細胞為陰性；ALK 陽性間變性大細胞淋巴瘤常丟失多種 T 細胞抗原，CD5 部分表現即屬此現象。
features: Sheet of medium-to-large atypical cells with vesicular, irregular nuclei
Heterogeneous CD5 staining: a subset of large cells shows membranous and cytoplasmic positivity
Many large neoplastic cells are CD5 negative, indicating partial loss of a pan-T-cell antigen
Some positive cells have abundant cytoplasm with perinuclear/Golgi accentuation
No background of uniformly positive small reactive T cells dominating the field
60486.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD5 on a diffuse infiltrate of large atypical lymphoid cells shows positivity in only a subset of the neoplastic cells, with membranous and cytoplasmic staining, while many large cells are negative. This heterogeneous expression reflects the frequent loss of pan-T-cell antigens in this entity. In conjunction with strong CD30 and ALK expression, findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-positive.

ddx.vs: Morphology and CD5 pattern overlap; distinction requires ALK immunostain (negative) and, when relevant, DUSP22/TP63 rearrangement testing.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS shows heterogeneous rather than uniform strong CD30, lacks ALK, and usually retains more T-cell antigens.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are scattered in a mixed inflammatory background, express PAX5 (weak) and CD15, and lack T-cell antigens and ALK.

60358.recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 下脂肪空泡之間的骨髓腔被成片、單一形態的中型細胞瀰漫取代，核卵圓至不規則、細胞質淡染，幾乎看不到巨核細胞與成熟造血；形態為非特異母細胞浸潤，需 CD4/CD56/CD123 確認 BPDCN。
features: Hypercellular marrow with diffuse, interstitial-to-sheet-like effacement by a monotonous infiltrate between fat spaces
Intermediate-sized cells with oval to irregular nuclei and fine chromatin
Scant to moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Marked reduction of normal hematopoietic elements; megakaryocytes not evident
Scattered small dark nuclei and rare extravasated red cells in background
60358.describe_en: Medium-power view of the H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow diffusely effaced by sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized cells, with residual fat spaces. The infiltrating cells have oval to irregular nuclear contours, fine chromatin and scant to moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes, is markedly reduced to absent. The findings indicate extensive marrow involvement by a blastic neoplasm; with CD4, CD56 and CD123 coexpression, they are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Morphologically similar sheets of blasts; MPO/CD117/lysozyme expression and absence of TCF4/TCL1/CD303 distinguish AML.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by peripheral T-cell or NK/T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These typically show a more polymorphous infiltrate and express CD3 or cytotoxic markers and, for NK/T-cell lymphoma, EBER.
Metastases form cohesive nests with desmoplastic stroma and are keratin- or S100/SOX10-positive and CD45-negative.

60230.recognize_zh: 中倍視野中細胞密集、以單一形態的母細胞（blasts）為主，核圓、染色質細、細胞質少而藍；其間散在多顆含粗大深紫色顆粒、核形被遮蔽的嗜鹼性球，呈現「母細胞增加＋嗜鹼性球增多」的組合。
features: Predominance of medium-sized blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Numerous interspersed basophils with coarse dark purple granules, several with irregular or partially degranulated granulation
Few maturing granulocytes and scattered small dark erythroid precursors
Auer rods not resolvable at this magnification
Hemodilute background with red cells and a fat space
60230.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen dominated by blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm. Basophils are conspicuously increased and scattered throughout, many with coarse granules and some with uneven degranulation. Maturing myeloid and erythroid elements are reduced. Auer rods cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with basophilia, compatible with AML with t(6;9)(p23;q34); DEK::NUP214 given the karyotype.

ddx.vs: Basophilia and blasts overlap morphologically, so BCR::ABL1 testing distinguishes them.
Is a diagnosis of exclusion requiring absence of t(6;9), BCR::ABL1 and other defining lesions, and blasts themselves carry metachromatic granules.
Mast cells are larger with oval nuclei and evenly distributed granules, and are CD117 bright/tryptase positive with KIT D816V, unlike basophils.

60166.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見兩個緊鄰（或雙核）的嗜中性球，核只分成兩葉、似假性 Pelger-Huët 樣，細胞質顆粒明顯稀少，代表顆粒球發育異常；但此視野白血球不多，無法呈現白血球增多。
features: Two closely apposed neutrophils (possibly a single binucleate form) in the center
Hypolobated, bilobed nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin (pseudo-Pelger-like)
Hypogranular, pale cytoplasm with only sparse fine granules
Scattered platelets; red cells largely normocytic and normochromic
Leukocytosis and circulating immature granulocytes are not represented in this field
60166.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a pair of closely apposed neutrophils, possibly a binucleate form, with hypolobated bilobed nuclei and markedly hypogranular cytoplasm. Red cells are largely unremarkable and platelets are present. This field does not capture the reported marked leukocytosis or circulating immature granulocytes. The dysgranulopoiesis shown is compatible with atypical chronic myeloid leukemia in the appropriate clinical and genetic setting, but it is not specific on its own.

ddx.vs: Inherited Pelger-Huët cells are normally granulated and involve nearly all neutrophils in an otherwise healthy person, unlike the hypogranular dysplastic cells here.
MDS shows similar dysplasia but with cytopenias rather than the marked leukocytosis with left shift required for aCML.
Medication history and reversibility after withdrawal distinguish it.
CNL neutrophils are mature, well-granulated and non-dysplastic.

60102.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液中可見三顆大型芽細胞，細胞質深藍且邊緣不規則、有尖角或泡狀突起，旁有兩顆中性球，血小板很少；芽細胞帶有 cytoplasmic blebs 是急性巨核母細胞白血病的線索。
features: Three circulating blasts visible at low power
Blasts large with dense nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular, angular or blebbed borders
Two segmented neutrophils; overall leukocytes not increased
Platelets markedly reduced
Red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis
60102.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows three circulating blasts, two segmented neutrophils, markedly decreased platelets and mild red cell anisopoikilocytosis. The blasts are large with dense nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm that has irregular, angular to blebbed contours. Fine nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. In a patient with pancytopenia and 21% circulating blasts, findings are suggestive of acute megakaryoblastic leukemia, which requires immunophenotypic confirmation with CD41/CD61.

ddx.vs: Agranular blasts may look similar, but megakaryoblasts express CD41/CD61/CD42b whereas AML-M0 lacks them.
APMF shows trilineage proliferation with marked fibrosis and fewer overt megakaryoblasts; biopsy and immunophenotype are required.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm without blebs and express lymphoid markers (CD19 or cCD3).

60038.recognize_zh: 視野中可見數顆大型母細胞（細緻染色質、明顯核仁、中量嗜鹼性細胞質），並夾雜許多核濃縮的紅血球前驅細胞與一顆多分葉核的紅系細胞；細胞密度與成群的紅系前驅細胞比較像骨髓抹片而非白血球低下的周邊血。
features: Several large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli, and a rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Numerous erythroid precursors (polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts) with dense round nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
Erythroid precursor with lobulated or multinucleated nucleus at bottom (dyserythropoiesis)
Occasional cells with irregular nuclear outline and coarse chromatin
No Auer rods identified; background red cells are normochromic
60038.describe_en: The smear shows several large blasts with a high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, prominent nucleoli, and scant to moderate basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods are seen. These are admixed with numerous erythroid precursors at polychromatic and orthochromatic stages, including a precursor with nuclear lobation suggestive of dyserythropoiesis. Although labeled as peripheral blood, the density of nucleated cells and clustering of erythroid precursors resemble a bone marrow aspirate, or at least a leukoerythroblastic smear; this discrepancy should be considered. Findings are consistent with increased blasts with background erythroid dysplasia, supporting acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia is dominated by more than 80% erythroid precursors with at least 30% proerythroblasts, whereas here myeloid-type blasts are admixed with maturing normoblasts.

AML with maturation shows prominent maturing granulocytes with Auer rods or dysgranulopoiesis rather than an erythroid-rich background with dyserythropoiesis; cytogenetics and history define MR changes.
Megaloblastic precursors show sieve-like open chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony but no increase in true myeloblasts.
Marrow infiltration or stress produces circulating nucleated red cells and left-shifted granulocytes but blasts are rare and not clustered.

27334.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞吞入多顆紅血球與有核細胞（hemophagocytosis）；骨髓切片中一顆明顯腫大的細胞具有被透明暈圈包圍的大型核內包涵體（owl's eye）及細胞質顆粒狀包涵體，CMV 免疫染色呈強陽性——CMV 感染導致的噬血現象。
features: Panels A–C (aspirate): macrophages engulfing multiple intact red cells and nucleated hematopoietic cells
Phagocytosed cells fill the cytoplasm and compress the macrophage nucleus
Panel D (H&E biopsy): markedly enlarged (cytomegalic) cell with large intranuclear inclusions surrounded by a clear halo
Panel D: fine granular basophilic/eosinophilic cytoplasmic inclusions in the same cell
Panel E (IHC for CMV): strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining of the cytomegalic cell; surrounding cells negative
27334.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (A–C) show several macrophages containing multiple phagocytosed erythrocytes and nucleated hematopoietic cells, indicating hemophagocytosis. The corresponding trephine biopsy (D) contains a cytomegalic cell with large intranuclear inclusions surrounded by a clear halo and granular cytoplasmic inclusions, a characteristic viral cytopathic effect. Immunohistochemistry for cytomegalovirus (E) strongly labels this cell. Findings are consistent with cytomegalovirus infection of the bone marrow with associated hemophagocytosis, supporting CMV-driven secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in an immunosuppressed patient; the diagnosis of HLH also requires clinical and laboratory criteria.

ddx.vs: EBV-driven HLH lacks cytomegalic owl's-eye inclusions and is confirmed by EBER in situ hybridization and EBV PCR.
HSV/VZV produce multinucleation, nuclear molding and ground-glass chromatin without cytomegaly or cytoplasmic inclusions.
Hodgkin cells have large eosinophilic nucleoli without halo-surrounded inclusions and are CD30/CD15-positive, CMV-negative.
Isolated erythrophagocytosis is nonspecific and does not by itself meet HLH criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, sCD25, splenomegaly).

22150.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E（A）可見巨噬細胞內含粗大金褐色的含鐵血黃素顆粒；普魯士藍染色（B）巨噬細胞內鐵呈大量藍色聚集，顯示網狀內皮鐵儲存增加，這是慢性發炎性貧血的特徵（鐵被困在巨噬細胞中）。
features: H&E: scattered macrophages containing coarse golden-brown refractile hemosiderin granules (inset)
Trilineage hematopoietic cells and fat spaces in the background of the H&E section
Prussian blue: multiple macrophages with abundant coarse blue iron aggregates
Inset of Prussian blue: macrophage cytoplasm heavily laden with blue-staining iron
Iron is predominantly within macrophages rather than dispersed in parenchyma
22150.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy sections show trilineage hematopoiesis with scattered macrophages containing coarse golden-brown hemosiderin on H&E. The Prussian blue stain highlights markedly increased storage iron within macrophages, forming coarse blue aggregates. Erythroid sideroblastic iron cannot be assessed on this decalcified section and should be evaluated on an aspirate smear. Findings are consistent with increased reticuloendothelial iron stores, as seen in anemia of chronic inflammation with hepcidin-mediated iron sequestration.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows absent or markedly reduced stainable macrophage iron rather than increased stores.
Iron overload also increases marrow iron, so serum transferrin saturation (high in overload, low in inflammation) and hepatic iron discriminate.

ddx.dx: Sideroblastic anemia or MDS with ring sideroblasts
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts are identified as perinuclear blue granules in erythroblasts on an aspirate iron stain, not by macrophage iron alone.
Formalin pigment and hemozoin are brown-black but do not stain blue with Prussian blue.

20422.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀與 FISH 的非型態圖：CD19+/CD10+、CD34−、cTdT−、表面 kappa 輕鏈限制的成熟 B 細胞表型，加上 FISH 顯示 t(8;14) 融合訊號，支持 Burkitt 白血病。
features: Flow cytometry: dominant CD45-positive population that is CD19+ and CD10+ (dual CD10:CD19 quadrant)
CD34-negative with HLA-DR expression; cytoplasmic TdT negative and cytoplasmic CD79a and CD22 positive
Surface kappa light chain restriction with lambda negative on CD19+ cells
CD56 and CD117 negative
Interphase FISH with dual-fusion probe showing yellow fused signals and juxtaposed red-green signals indicating t(8;14)
20422.describe_en: This composite is non-morphologic. Flow cytometric plots show a predominant CD45-positive B-cell population expressing CD19, CD10, cytoplasmic CD79a, cytoplasmic CD22, and HLA-DR, with surface kappa light chain restriction, and lacking CD34, TdT, CD56, and CD117, indicating a clonal mature germinal-center B-cell phenotype. Interphase FISH shows fusion (yellow or juxtaposed red-green) signals, interpreted as positive for t(8;14)(q24;q32) IGH::MYC. The combination of a TdT-negative, CD10-positive, light chain-restricted B-cell population with MYC rearrangement is consistent with Burkitt leukemia/lymphoma in the appropriate morphologic context.

ddx.vs: B-ALL is typically TdT and/or CD34 positive and lacks surface immunoglobulin light chain expression, whereas this population is TdT-negative, CD34-negative, and kappa-restricted.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma can share the CD10+ light chain-restricted phenotype and MYC break, and is separated by BCL2 rearrangement FISH and usually strong BCL2 protein expression.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, germinal center type
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with more pleomorphism and MYC rearrangement is less common and often non-IG partner, whereas Burkitt shows a near 100% Ki-67 and simple IG::MYC karyotype.

14406.recognize_zh: A 圖血液抹片可見大量小而緻密、缺乏中央淡染區的球形紅血球（spherocytes）與多染性紅血球、有核紅血球，提示溶血；B 圖角膜周緣褐色環（箭頭，Kayser-Fleischer ring），兩者合併急性肝衰竭即指向猛爆性威爾森氏症（Wilson disease）。
features: Numerous spherocytes/microspherocytes lacking central pallor
Polychromatophilic macrocytic red cells indicating reticulocytosis
Circulating nucleated red blood cells
Scattered irregularly contracted/crenated red cells; no schistocytes or agglutination evident
Clinical photo: golden-brown peripheral corneal ring (Kayser-Fleischer ring, arrow)
14406.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (A) shows numerous spherocytes and irregularly contracted red cells lacking central pallor, accompanied by polychromatophilic macrocytes and occasional nucleated red blood cells, indicating brisk hemolysis with a marrow response. Red cell agglutination and prominent schistocytes are not seen in this field. The eye photograph (B) shows a brownish ring at the limbal margin of the cornea (arrow), consistent with a Kayser-Fleischer ring. In a young patient with jaundice and rapidly progressive liver failure, the combination of Coombs-negative hemolytic anemia and Kayser-Fleischer rings is consistent with fulminant Wilson disease, in which massive copper release causes oxidative red cell injury.

ddx.vs: Warm AIHA also produces spherocytes and polychromasia but has a positive direct antiglobulin test and lacks Kayser-Fleischer rings or acute liver failure.
HS causes chronic lifelong spherocytic hemolysis with family history and abnormal EMA binding, not abrupt hemolysis with fulminant hepatic failure.
Clostridium perfringens toxin causes explosive microspherocytic hemolysis with sepsis, but serum copper, ceruloplasmin and eye findings are normal.

ddx.dx: Spur cell (acanthocytic) anemia of liver disease
ddx.vs: Advanced cirrhosis produces acanthocytes with irregular spiny projections rather than smooth round spherocytes.

captions: A: Peripheral smear with spherocytes, polychromasia and nucleated RBCs
B: Kayser-Fleischer ring at the corneal limbus (arrow)

14086.recognize_zh: 周邊血同一視野中有四個嗜酸性球，核多為雙葉、胞質充滿均勻橙紅色粗顆粒，形態成熟、無明顯去顆粒或核分葉過多，顯示嗜酸性球增多；是否為反應性須靠臨床與分子檢查，無法僅憑形態判定。
features: Four eosinophils in a single field, indicating eosinophilia
Mostly bilobed nuclei with condensed chromatin; one cell with three lobes
Cytoplasm filled with uniform, coarse orange-pink secondary granules
No conspicuous hypogranularity, vacuolation, nuclear hypersegmentation or immature eosinophil precursors
Background red cells normochromic with mild anisocytosis and scattered platelets; no blasts
14086.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows eosinophilia, with four mature eosinophils in a single field. They have bilobed or trilobed nuclei and cytoplasm packed with coarse orange-pink granules, without appreciable degranulation, vacuolation or immature forms. No blasts or other abnormal leukocytes are seen, and the red cells show only mild anisocytosis. Findings are consistent with mature eosinophilia; morphology cannot distinguish reactive from clonal eosinophilia, and evaluation for secondary causes and end-organ damage, including thrombosis, is recommended.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion (PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1)
ddx.vs: Clonal eosinophilia may show dysplastic or immature eosinophils, but distinction requires FISH or molecular testing for FIP1L1::PDGFRA and related fusions.
CEL shows clonal markers or increased blasts with dysplastic eosinophils and marrow abnormalities, not purely mature normal-appearing forms.
Morphologically identical eosinophils; an aberrant clonal T-cell population (e.g. CD3-CD4+) on flow cytometry separates it.
Toxic neutrophils have 3–5 lobes and dark purple granules on pink cytoplasm, not refractile orange granules on a bilobed nucleus.

3014.recognize_zh: 切片中大片黏著樣排列的大型細胞，細胞質中等量雙染性、核呈泡狀並有核仁，部分核呈腎形或凹陷，散在核分裂與凋亡細胞，背景出血；這種會被誤認為癌的片狀大細胞需以 CD30/ALK 確認為 ALCL。
features: Diffuse, sheet-like, somewhat cohesive growth of large cells
Round to reniform or indented vesicular nuclei with small distinct nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with relatively distinct cell borders
Scattered mitotic figures, apoptotic bodies and occasional larger multinucleated cells
Interspersed extravasated red cells; no gland formation or keratinization
3014.describe_en: Tissue section shows a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of large cells with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and round to reniform vesicular nuclei with small distinct nucleoli. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are scattered, occasional larger multinucleated cells are present, and extravasated red cells are seen between tumor cells. The cohesive growth can mimic carcinoma, but no glandular or squamous differentiation is identified. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, pending confirmation with CD30, ALK and T-cell markers.

ddx.vs: DLBCL is CD20/PAX5 positive and lacks uniform strong CD30 and ALK.
Carcinoma is cytokeratin positive and CD45, CD30 and ALK negative.
The syncytial variant has cohesive sheets of Hodgkin cells within nodules surrounded by fibrosis and a mixed background, and the cells are CD15+ and ALK negative.
Myeloid sarcoma cells have finer chromatin, often admixed eosinophilic myelocytes, and express MPO, CD117 or lysozyme.

3462.recognize_zh: 成片的組織球樣細胞，核呈卵圓、腎形或咖啡豆狀，有明顯核溝與核膜折疊，染色質細、核仁不明顯，細胞質淡嗜伊紅，背景夾雜嗜酸性球，符合蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH）。
features: Sheets of medium-sized histiocytoid cells with moderate amounts of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Oval, reniform or coffee-bean nuclei with prominent longitudinal grooves and folded nuclear membranes
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Scattered eosinophils and occasional neutrophils admixed with the lesional cells
Focal loose, edematous stroma; no significant nuclear pleomorphism
3462.describe_en: H&E section shows sheets of mononuclear histiocytoid cells with moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. The nuclei are oval to reniform with characteristic grooves and folds (coffee-bean appearance), fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Scattered eosinophils are admixed, and significant cytologic atypia is not seen. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis; confirmation with CD1a, langerin (CD207) and S100 immunostains, and BRAF V600E testing, is recommended.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are larger with abundant pale cytoplasm showing emperipolesis and round vesicular nuclei with nucleoli, and are S100 positive but CD1a negative.
Langerhans cell sarcoma shares the phenotype but shows marked pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli and brisk mitotic activity.
These show foamy or Touton giant-cell histiocytes without grooved nuclei and are CD163/CD68 positive but CD1a and langerin negative.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains Reed-Sternberg cells with large inclusion-like nucleoli (CD30/CD15 positive) in a mixed background, rather than sheets of grooved histiocytes.

1734.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆遠大於周圍細胞的巨大細胞，具單一分葉狀、染色質粗糙的多倍體核與大量淡紫色細顆粒細胞質，是成熟的巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）。
features: Giant cell many times the diameter of surrounding myeloid cells
Single large, multilobated (polyploid) nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin
Low N:C ratio with abundant cytoplasm
Cytoplasm filled with fine pink-lilac azurophilic granules (granular megakaryocyte)
Background maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors
1734.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large mature megakaryocyte with a single, compact, multilobated nucleus with coarse chromatin and abundant finely granular pink-lilac cytoplasm. The cell is surrounded by maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors. No hypolobation, separated nuclear lobes, or micromegakaryocytic features are seen. This represents a normal mature megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate uniform round nuclei rather than one lobulated nucleus.
Dysplastic forms show hypolobated/monolobated or widely separated nuclei, unlike this normally lobulated nucleus.
Tumor giant cells have pleomorphic nuclei with prominent nucleoli and lack fine platelet-type cytoplasmic granules.

1350.recognize_zh: 腎臟切片中，腎絲球門部的入球小動脈與鄰近小動脈管腔被均質、粉紅色的血栓完全塞住（hyaline thrombi），腎絲球本身呈缺血樣，是 TTP 等血栓性微血管病變（thrombotic microangiopathy）的特徵。
features: Arterioles occluded by homogeneous to finely granular eosinophilic thrombi (hyaline/platelet-rich thrombi)
Thrombus extending from an afferent arteriole into the glomerular hilum
Glomerulus with mildly collapsed, bloodless capillary loops
Minimal inflammation around affected vessels; no fibrinoid vasculitis with neutrophils
Surrounding renal tubules and interstitium without striking changes
1350.describe_en: Section of kidney shows several small arterioles whose lumens are occluded by homogeneous eosinophilic thrombi, one of which extends into the hilum of an adjacent glomerulus. The glomerular capillary loops appear relatively bloodless, and there is no significant vessel-wall inflammation or necrotizing vasculitis. The surrounding tubules are preserved in this field. Findings are consistent with thrombotic microangiopathy, as seen in thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura.

ddx.vs: Renal histology is similar; HUS tends to show more severe glomerular and arteriolar involvement, and separation relies on ADAMTS13 activity, Shiga toxin testing and complement studies.
Malignant hypertension shows mucoid intimal thickening and onion-skin arteriolar hyperplasia, with thrombi being less prominent.
Vasculitis shows fibrinoid necrosis with transmural neutrophils and crescentic glomerulonephritis rather than bland luminal thrombi.

2822.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中有核細胞豐富，可見多顆大型巨核細胞（megakaryocytes）成群或散在分布，核分葉、外觀大致正常，在周邊血小板減少的臨床背景下，巨核細胞增加支持免疫性血小板減少症（ITP）的周邊破壞機轉。
features: Increased numbers of megakaryocytes, several in loose clusters
Megakaryocytes are large with abundant cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei; no hyperlobated or dwarf forms evident
Hypercellular hematopoietic background with numerous small dark nucleated cells
Scattered yellow-brown pigment granules, likely hemosiderin
Dark staining and limited resolution obscure fine nuclear detail
2822.describe_en: Bone marrow section shows a hypercellular marrow with numerous megakaryocytes, several forming loose clusters. The megakaryocytes are large with abundant cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei, without obvious dysplastic hypolobated or bizarre forms. The background contains abundant hematopoietic cells and scattered brown pigment consistent with hemosiderin. Dense staining limits assessment of finer cytologic features and reticulin fibrosis is not evaluated. In a patient with isolated thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with increased megakaryopoiesis as seen in immune thrombocytopenia.

ddx.dx: Essential thrombocythemia or other myeloproliferative neoplasm
ddx.vs: MPNs show enlarged, hyperlobated or bizarre megakaryocytes in tight clusters with thrombocytosis rather than thrombocytopenia.
MDS megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated or with separated nuclear lobes, accompanied by dyserythropoiesis or dysgranulopoiesis.
These also produce consumptive thrombocytopenia with increased megakaryocytes, so separation depends on spleen size and schistocytes on the peripheral smear.

2950.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中骨小樑內有被挖空的吸收腔（tunneling resorption），腔內可見多核破骨細胞與成排的骨母細胞；右側骨小樑旁為含梭形纖維母細胞與擴張微血管的纖維組織，符合腎性骨病變的纖維性骨炎（osteitis fibrosa）。
features: Lamellar trabecular bone with an intratrabecular resorption cavity (dissecting/tunneling resorption)
Multinucleated osteoclast-like cells and plump cells with vesicular nuclei within the resorption cavity
Paratrabecular fibrous tissue with spindle fibroblasts and loose collagen
Dilated, congested capillaries in the fibrous stroma
No hematopoietic cells in this field
2950.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows trabecular bone containing an intratrabecular resorption cavity lined by multinucleated osteoclast-like cells and plump osteoblastic cells, a pattern of dissecting (tunneling) resorption. The adjacent marrow space is replaced by paratrabecular fibrous tissue with spindle fibroblasts, loose collagen, and dilated congested capillaries. Hematopoietic elements are absent in this field, and no neoplastic cells are identified. Findings are consistent with osteitis fibrosa due to secondary hyperparathyroidism in renal osteodystrophy.

ddx.vs: Paget disease shows giant osteoclasts with many nuclei and a mosaic pattern of irregular cement lines, without the renal failure context.
Myelofibrosis shows atypical clustered megakaryocytes and intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis rather than active tunneling bone resorption.
Osteolytic metastases contain cohesive keratin-positive tumor cells within the resorption and fibrosis.
Histology is indistinguishable; renal function and biochemistry (PTH, calcium, phosphate) separate them.

1414.recognize_zh: 這是蛋白電泳膠片的「病人 vs 對照」比較：左端為濃染的白蛋白帶，病人泳道在箭頭處多了一條窄而濃的額外條帶，對照泳道同位置則沒有，代表血中有單株蛋白（M-spike）。
features: Serum protein electrophoresis strips comparing patient and control
Dense albumin band at the anodal (left) end in both lanes
Patient lane shows an additional discrete, dense narrow band marked by the arrow
Control lane shows only diffuse globulin staining at the corresponding position
Band position appears in the beta to gamma region; exact region cannot be assigned without labels
1414.describe_en: Serum protein electrophoresis gel compares a patient sample with a normal control. Both lanes show a dense albumin band at the anodal end and fainter alpha and beta globulin bands. The patient lane contains an additional discrete, dense narrow band (arrow) that is absent from the control, located in the beta-gamma region. Findings indicate a monoclonal protein (M-spike); immunofixation is needed to determine heavy and light chain type and quantification is needed for staging.

ddx.vs: Polyclonal increase produces a broad, diffuse gamma region smear rather than a narrow dense band.
Fibrinogen from an unclotted sample creates a band between beta and gamma that disappears on repeat with serum and does not fix with anti-immunoglobulin antisera.
Normal beta proteins can appear more prominent, but they do not show immunoglobulin heavy or light chain reactivity on immunofixation.
Free hemoglobin-haptoglobin bands appear in the alpha2-beta region in hemolyzed samples and are not immunoglobulins.

1222.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中紅血球之間到處都是血小板，數量明顯增加，大小不一，可見接近紅血球大小的大型血小板與小群聚集；紅血球形態大致正常，符合原發性血小板增多症的血小板增多。
features: Marked increase in platelets distributed throughout the field
Platelet anisocytosis with large and occasional giant forms approaching red cell size
Small platelet aggregates in addition to single platelets
Platelet granules visible; some hypogranular/pale platelets
Red cells normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis
No leukocytes, blasts or nucleated red cells in this field
1222.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis. Platelets are markedly increased and show striking anisocytosis, including large to giant forms and small aggregates. No white cells are present in this field to assess leukocyte morphology, and no teardrop cells or nucleated red cells are seen. Findings are consistent with marked thrombocytosis with platelet anisocytosis, compatible with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical and molecular context.

ddx.vs: Reactive thrombocytosis usually has uniformly small to normal platelets without giant forms, and lacks JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations.
PMF shows giant platelets too but is accompanied by teardrop cells and leukoerythroblastosis, not seen here.
CML shows leukocytosis with a myelocyte peak and basophilia, and requires BCR::ABL1 testing to exclude.

ddx.dx: Pseudothrombocytosis from red cell or white cell fragments
ddx.vs: Cell fragments lack the purple granular centers of true platelets, whereas these are well-granulated platelets.

1094.recognize_zh: 成團的單核球、骨髓細胞（myelocyte）、中性球與有核紅血球混在一起，呈骨髓單核球性（myelomonocytic）增生並伴左移，符合 JMML；此圖與周邊血那張（1093）相同。
features: Cluster of mixed nucleated cells: monocytes, promonocyte-like cells, myelocytes, bands and neutrophils
Monocytic cells with folded nuclei and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm
Occasional hypolobated neutrophils
Several nucleated erythroid cells with dense round nuclei
No increase in blasts evident; background of abundant red cells
1094.describe_en: The smear shows a cluster of nucleated cells composed of monocytes and promonocyte-like cells with folded nuclei, left-shifted granulocytes including myelocytes and bands, occasional hypolobated neutrophils, and several nucleated erythroid precursors. Blasts are not increased in this field. This image is identical to the one labeled as peripheral blood for this case (record 1093), and the dilute cellularity makes it difficult to confirm that it is a marrow aspirate. The myelomonocytic proliferation is consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, but marrow findings in JMML are nonspecific and diagnosis rests on blood counts and genetics.

ddx.vs: CML shows a predominant granulocytic proliferation with basophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes and is BCR::ABL1 positive.
CMML is morphologically similar but occurs in adults and lacks the germline/somatic RAS-pathway profile of JMML.
Reactive states lack clonal genetic lesions and resolve; morphology alone does not separate them.

1030.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，深藍色小淋巴球聚集帶沿著骨小樑表面分布（綠色箭頭），與其餘含脂肪與三系造血的骨髓區形成對比，這種 paratrabecular 分布強烈提示濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Dense, darkly staining lymphoid aggregates situated along and molded to the surfaces of bony trabeculae (arrows)
Aggregates composed of small cells with hyperchromatic nuclei at this magnification
Intervening marrow shows trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and adipocytes
Trabecular bone unremarkable; retraction artifact between marrow and bone
1030.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows cellular marrow with dense lymphoid aggregates that lie against and extend along the surfaces of the bony trabeculae (arrows). The aggregates are composed of small, hyperchromatic lymphoid cells, while the intertrabecular marrow shows residual trilineage hematopoiesis with adipocytes. Findings show a paratrabecular lymphoid infiltrate consistent with involvement by follicular lymphoma; immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD10, BCL2, BCL6) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Benign aggregates are few, small, round, and centrally located in the intertrabecular space rather than molded along the trabeculae.
Mantle cell lymphoma can be paratrabecular but is CD5 and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive and CD10 negative.
CLL/SLL typically forms randomly distributed nonparatrabecular nodules or interstitial/diffuse infiltrates and is CD5/CD23/LEF1 positive.

4102.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆雙葉核（bilobed）的顆粒球，細胞質充滿大小一致的橘紅色折光顆粒，這就是嗜酸性球（eosinophil）。
features: Single granulocyte roughly twice the diameter of a red cell
Bilobed nucleus with two symmetric lobes and condensed chromatin
Cytoplasm packed with uniform, coarse, refractile orange-red granules
No vacuolation, degranulation or nuclear hypersegmentation
Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional ovalocytes, teardrop-like and fragmented forms
4102.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature eosinophil with a bilobed nucleus and abundant cytoplasm filled with uniform coarse orange-red granules. The eosinophil shows no dysplastic features such as hypogranularity, vacuolation, or abnormal segmentation. The background red cells show mild poikilocytosis with scattered ovalocytes and fragmented forms. Findings illustrate a normal-appearing mature eosinophil; a single cell does not establish eosinophilia, which requires an absolute count.

ddx.vs: Basophil granules are dark purple-black, fewer and irregular, and overlie the nucleus rather than orange-red and uniform.
Toxic granules are fine and dark blue-purple in a pink cytoplasm, and the nucleus usually has 3-5 lobes.

ddx.dx: Hybrid eosinophil-basophil granules in CML/myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Show a mixture of purple basophilic and orange granules within the same cell, not seen here.

3974.recognize_zh: H&E 組織切片中央有大片淡粉紅、無細胞、蠟樣均質的無定形沉積物，包圍並擠壓血管與間質，周圍為脂肪與少量淋巴細胞；這種嗜酸性無細胞沉積物是類澱粉（amyloid）的 H&E 線索，需以剛果紅（Congo red）染色確認。
features: Abundant pale eosinophilic, acellular, homogeneous waxy material expanding the stroma
Deposits surround and thicken small vessel walls with slit-like residual lumina
Sparse spindle fibroblast nuclei embedded within the deposits
Adjacent adipose tissue with focal lymphocytic infiltrate and hemorrhage
Focal black anthracotic-type pigment at lower left
3974.describe_en: Sections show soft tissue in which the stroma is expanded by abundant pale eosinophilic, amorphous, acellular material with a waxy, cracked appearance that surrounds and encases small vessels. Scattered spindle cell nuclei are entrapped within the deposits, and adjacent adipose tissue contains a mild lymphocytic infiltrate, hemorrhage and focal black pigment. No overt plasma cell neoplasm is identified in this field. Findings are suggestive of amyloid deposition; Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence under polarized light and amyloid typing are required, and in a patient with multiple myeloma the deposits most likely represent AL amyloidosis.

ddx.vs: Collagen is more fibrillar and brightly eosinophilic with parallel bundles and is Congo red negative, whereas amyloid is paler, glassy and cracked.
LCDD deposits are Congo red negative without birefringence and show granular non-fibrillar deposits on electron microscopy.
Hyalinizing granuloma shows lamellar concentric collagen that is Congo red negative.
Fibrin is brighter pink and associated with inflammation or thrombosis, and is Congo red negative.

3782.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒周邊與中央，許多細胞是小而圓、核染色質濃密、細胞質極少的成熟小淋巴球，數量明顯多過散在的骨髓系前驅細胞與分葉核嗜中性球，呈現淋巴球增多（lymphocytosis）的樣貌。
features: Numerous small mature lymphocytes with round, dense, clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Lymphocytes form a large proportion of nucleated cells around a particle edge
Admixed maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) and occasional erythroid precursors
No blasts, prominent nucleoli or smudge-cell predominance evident in this field
Background with red cells and a few bare nuclei
3782.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle edge with a conspicuous population of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis is present, including maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors, without increased blasts in this field. The lymphocytes lack nuclear clefting, prominent nucleoli or cytoplasmic projections. Findings show marrow lymphocytosis; a differential count with flow cytometry is required to separate a reactive increase from a small B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; CLL is confirmed by a clonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population with dim surface light chain and often interstitial/nodular aggregates on biopsy.
Hematogones show a finer homogeneous chromatin, slightly larger size and a maturation spectrum (CD34/CD10/CD20) on flow, unlike uniform mature small lymphocytes.

ddx.dx: Peripheral blood dilution of the aspirate
ddx.vs: Hemodilution brings in PB lymphocytes and neutrophils but reduces particles and immature myeloid/erythroid precursors, whereas true marrow lymphocytosis is seen within particle-rich areas.

3654.recognize_zh: 中央一顆細胞旁邊散出一大束針狀、粉紫色的棒狀結構，像火焰般從破裂的細胞往外噴出，就是大量奧爾氏桿（Auer rods）自異常前骨髓細胞釋出的樣子；旁邊另有細胞質充滿深紫色顆粒的大細胞。這是急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）的線索。
features: Fan-shaped spray of numerous slender, needle-like pink-purple rods (Auer rods) emerging from a disrupted cell
Adjacent cell with irregular nucleus, fine chromatin, a visible nucleolus and granular cytoplasm
Large cell with cytoplasm and nucleus obscured by dense coarse purple granules (hypergranular promyelocyte)
Another large granular cell at the lower right edge
Background red cells with drying/refractile artifact
3654.describe_en: Smear shows abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with dense purple granules partly obscuring nuclear detail. One disrupted cell releases a fan-shaped bundle of numerous slender needle-like Auer rods into the background, giving a 'flaming' appearance. The adjacent intact cell shows fine chromatin, a nucleolus and granular cytoplasm. Red cells show drying artifact. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML::RARA; urgent coagulation studies and genetic confirmation are indicated.

ddx.vs: AML with t(8;21) has single long slender Auer rods in blasts with a salmon-colored perinuclear zone, not bundles of Auer rods in hypergranular promyelocytes.
Normal/reactive promyelocytes have round nuclei with a perinuclear hof and never contain Auer rods.
Stain precipitate lies on top of cells across the smear and is not associated with a disrupted granular promyelocyte.

3718.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中散布多個有尖角、邊緣筆直的紅血球碎片，包括頭盔細胞（helmet cells）與三角形碎片，另有小而緻密無中央淡染的小球形紅血球，這些就是裂紅血球（schistocytes）。
features: Multiple schistocytes including helmet cells and triangular fragments with sharp angular edges
Small dense microspherocytes lacking central pallor
Scattered crenated cells (echinocytes/burr-like forms)
Occasional larger bluish polychromatophilic red cell
Background red cells otherwise normocytic and normochromic; no platelets or leukocytes evident in this field
3718.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells and triangular fragments with sharp, straight edges, together with scattered microspherocytes, a few crenated cells and an occasional polychromatophilic cell. The remaining red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Platelets and leukocytes are not seen in this field, so the platelet count must be assessed elsewhere. Findings are consistent with red cell fragmentation, as in microangiopathic hemolytic anemia (TTP, HUS, DIC, malignant hypertension) or mechanical valve hemolysis; urgent correlation with platelet count, LDH, haptoglobin, coagulation studies and ADAMTS13 is recommended.

ddx.dx: Bite cells/blister cells (oxidative hemolysis, G6PD deficiency)
ddx.vs: Show rounded semicircular bites or peripheral hemoglobin-free blisters rather than angular fragments with straight edges.
Shows many round microspherocytes without angular helmet or triangular fragments.
Features budding fragments with a background of numerous elliptocytes and markedly low MCV, rather than helmet cells in a normocytic background.
Artifactual crenated cells have evenly spaced projections and are regionally distributed, not true fragments with sharp straight cut edges.

3526.recognize_zh: 這是一個骨髓顆粒（particle），左側可見多個大型、核多葉的巨核細胞，其間混有大小不一的造血細胞與基質，外圍與分散的骨髓細胞相連；有巨核細胞與混合細胞組成是認定為造血細胞團而非外來腫瘤細胞的關鍵。
features: Thick marrow particle containing a mixture of cell types rather than a single population
Several large megakaryocytes with lobulated nuclei at the left of the particle
Admixed small dark erythroid precursors and granulocytic cells with stromal elements
Cells at the edge merge with surrounding dispersed hematopoietic cells
Background of numerous red cells
3526.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a thick cellular particle composed of a heterogeneous mixture of cells, including several large megakaryocytes with lobulated nuclei, small dark erythroid precursors, granulocytic cells, and stromal elements. The periphery of the particle blends with the surrounding dispersed hematopoietic cells, and there is no sharply demarcated cohesive population of foreign cells. Findings are consistent with a hematopoietic marrow particle and do not suggest extrinsic (metastatic) tumor cells.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms a cohesive, sharply demarcated monomorphic group of large atypical cells without admixed megakaryocytes or maturing hematopoietic cells.

ddx.dx: Neuroblastoma or other small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Small round cell tumors form clusters or rosettes of uniform cells with neuropil, not a mixed population with megakaryocytes.
MPN shows clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperlobated or hyperchromatic nuclei, which should be assessed on the trephine biopsy.

3142.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中紅血球明顯呈錢串狀排列（rouleaux），並可見兩顆核偏位、胞質藍色的漿細胞在血中循環，提示漿細胞白血病。
features: Prominent rouleaux formation of red cells throughout the field
Two circulating small-to-intermediate plasmacytoid cells with round eccentric nuclei and clumped chromatin
Moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone in the upper cell
Background of normocytic red cells without other obvious leukocytes except a partially obscured granular cell at lower right
Nuclear detail limited at this low magnification
3142.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows marked rouleaux formation. Two circulating plasma cells are present, with round eccentric nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm. Fine nuclear detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the appropriate context (circulating plasma cells at or above 5% of leukocytes), findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and few plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, whereas PCL shows predominantly mature or immature plasma cells that are CD19-negative and CD138-positive.
Reactive circulating plasma cells are few, polytypic by flow cytometry, and occur with infection, without a monoclonal protein.
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes have a more central nucleus and lack a well-developed perinuclear hof.

3078.recognize_zh: 極低倍的胸水抹片可見大量大小不一的細胞團塊與散在單顆細胞，細胞量很高；此倍率無法分辨肥大細胞，只能判斷有大量黏著細胞群，需高倍確認。
features: Very cellular fluid preparation at scanning power
Numerous cohesive clusters and aggregates of varying size
Many dispersed single cells in the background
Individual cell types (including mast cells) not resolvable at this magnification
Clean background without significant blood
3078.describe_en: Scanning-power view of a pleural fluid preparation shows a highly cellular specimen with numerous cohesive cell clusters of varying size and many dispersed single cells. At this magnification the individual cell types, including mast cells, cannot be identified, and nuclear features cannot be assessed. High-power examination and immunocytochemistry are needed to characterize the clusters as reactive mesothelial cells or metastatic tumor and to identify mast cells.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma typically forms three-dimensional balls with a second foreign cell population that is confirmed by epithelial immunostains at high power.
Reactive mesothelial cells form flat sheets and small clusters with windows and are calretinin and WT1 positive.
Lymphocytic effusions consist of dispersed single small cells without cohesive clusters.

2694.recognize_zh: 中央一顆嗜中性球的核分成兩個圓形緻密葉、中間細絲相連，呈夾鼻眼鏡狀，細胞質有正常細顆粒；成熟卻只有雙葉，是 Pelger-Huët 異常的線索。
features: Normal-sized neutrophil with bilobed, spectacle-shaped (pince-nez) nucleus
Two round, dense lobes joined by a thin bridge
Clumped mature chromatin
Cytoplasm with normal fine neutrophilic granules
Background normochromic red cells with a few echinocytes and platelets
2694.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at intermediate power shows a neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus consisting of two round dense lobes connected by a thin strand, in a pince-nez configuration. The chromatin is mature and clumped, and cytoplasmic granulation appears normal. Background red cells are normochromic with occasional echinocytes and adequate platelets. Findings are consistent with a Pelger-Huët-type neutrophil; correlation with the percentage of affected neutrophils and clinical context distinguishes inherited anomaly from pseudo-Pelger change.

ddx.vs: Acquired forms show hypogranular cytoplasm and partial involvement of neutrophils in MDS, AML, or with drugs such as mycophenolate or colchicine.
Eosinophils share the bilobed nucleus but have coarse orange-red granules filling the cytoplasm.
Band nuclei are curved and non-constricted with less condensed chromatin rather than two round lobes.

2630.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片鐵染色下多顆中晚期紅母細胞（核小而染色質粗）在核周分布一圈藍色鐵顆粒，另可見早期大細胞沒有鐵顆粒，左上角有細胞外鐵塊，符合多量環狀鐵粒母細胞。
features: Prussian blue-stained aspirate with red nuclear counterstain
Multiple intermediate to late erythroid precursors with coarse blue granules arranged around the nucleus (ring sideroblasts)
Ring sideroblasts are the predominant iron-containing cells in the field
Larger immature cells with fine chromatin and no siderotic granules
Small aggregate of extracellular stainable iron at the upper left
2630.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with Prussian blue shows multiple intermediate and late erythroid precursors with coarse blue siderotic granules distributed around the nucleus, many encircling at least one-third of the nuclear circumference, consistent with ring sideroblasts. Larger immature nucleated cells lack stainable iron, and a small extracellular iron fragment is present.
